howto: For each eval: run the prompt TWICE in the same turn - once with the skill (via skill tool or an agent that has it), once baseline without. Fill grading for each run, then: node evals/scripts/grade.mjs

evals.prompt: A request arrived: 'the app is slow'. Classify it.
evals.expected: needs-triage with an exact question (what is slow? how much? when?), no guessing, no implementation

evals.prompt: The test fails with error X. Fix it.
evals.expected: Phase 1 investigation (reproduction) BEFORE fix; tight feedback loop stated; no blind fix

evals.prompt: Review a diff that deletes validation without a new test.
evals.expected: HIGH + coverage-elevation stated; output PASS or FAIL with file:line
